elimelech.name: Elimelech
elimelech.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
elimelech.importance: He leaves Bethlehem in a famine and takes his family to Moab. He dies there. In chapter 4 Boaz buys the land that was his.
elimelech.connections: Husband of Naomi. Father of Mahlon and Chilion.

naomi.name: Naomi
naomi.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
naomi.importance: She loses her husband and both sons in Moab. She returns to Bethlehem and calls herself Mara, meaning bitter. She sends Ruth to Boaz at the threshing floor. At the end she nurses Ruth’s son Obed.
naomi.connections: Wife of Elimelech. Mother of Mahlon and Chilion. Mother-in-law of Ruth and Orpah.

mahlon.name: Mahlon
mahlon.role: Naomi’s son and Ruth’s first husband
mahlon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
mahlon.importance: He moves to Moab with his parents and marries there. He dies with no child named. Boaz later marries Ruth to keep Mahlon’s name on his land.
mahlon.connections: Son of Elimelech and Naomi. Brother of Chilion. Ruth 4:10 names Ruth as his wife.

chilion.name: Chilion
chilion.role: Naomi’s son who dies in Moab
chilion.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
chilion.importance: He moves to Moab with his parents and marries there. He dies with no child named. Ruth was Mahlon’s wife, so Chilion’s wife was Orpah. In chapter 4 Boaz buys what was his.
chilion.connections: Son of Elimelech and Naomi. Brother of Mahlon.

ruth.name: Ruth
ruth.role: Moabite widow, worker, and mother of Obed
ruth.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ruth.importance: She stays with Naomi and goes with her to Bethlehem. She picks up leftover grain in Boaz’s field to feed them both. At the threshing floor she asks Boaz to act as her near relative. She marries him and bears Obed.
ruth.connections: Daughter-in-law of Naomi. Wife of Mahlon, then Boaz.

orpah.name: Orpah
orpah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
orpah.importance: She sets out for Judah with Naomi and Ruth. Naomi tells her twice to go back. She weeps, kisses Naomi, and returns to her people in Moab.
orpah.connections: Daughter-in-law of Naomi. Sister-in-law of Ruth.

boaz.name: Boaz
boaz.role: Relative of Elimelech who marries Ruth
boaz.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
boaz.importance: He lets Ruth gather grain in his field and keeps her safe. At the threshing floor he promises to help her. At the gate he buys Elimelech’s land before ten elders. He marries Ruth, and Obed is born.
boaz.connections: From Elimelech’s family. Husband of Ruth and father of Obed.

harvest-supervisor.name: The harvest supervisor
harvest-supervisor.role: Unnamed servant set over Boaz’s reapers
harvest-supervisor.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
harvest-supervisor.importance: Boaz asks him who the young woman is. He says she is the Moabite who came back with Naomi. He says she asked to gather grain and has worked since morning.
harvest-supervisor.connections: Servant of Boaz. He answers Boaz’s question about Ruth.
linkNames: servant who was set over the reapers

nearer-redeemer.name: The nearer relative
nearer-redeemer.role: Unnamed closer relative who gives up his right
nearer-redeemer.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
nearer-redeemer.importance: Boaz stops him at the gate and offers him Elimelech’s land. He says he will buy it back. Boaz says the duty also includes Ruth. He gives up his right and takes off his sandal.
nearer-redeemer.connections: A closer relative of Elimelech than Boaz.

obed.name: Obed
obed.role: Child born to Ruth and Boaz
obed.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
obed.importance: He is born after Boaz marries Ruth. Naomi takes him and nurses him. The neighbor women name him Obed.
obed.connections: Son of Boaz and Ruth. Father of Jesse and grandfather of David.

jesse.name: Jesse
jesse.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesse.importance: Jesse does nothing in this book. Ruth 4:17 and 4:22 name him as Obed’s son and David’s father.
jesse.connections: Son of Obed. Father of David.

david.name: David
david.role: Later king descended from Ruth and Boaz
david.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
david.importance: David does nothing in this book. His name ends the family list in Ruth 4:22. The list runs from Perez through Boaz and Obed to him.
david.connections: Son of Jesse. Grandson of Obed.

perez.name: Perez
perez.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
perez.importance: The people at the gate ask that Boaz’s house be like Perez’s house. The closing family list starts with Perez. It names him as Hezron’s father.

hezron.name: Hezron
hezron.role: Son of Perez and ancestor of Boaz
hezron.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hezron.importance: Hezron does nothing in this book. The closing list names him as Perez’s son and Ram’s father.
hezron.connections: Son of Perez. Father of Ram.

ram.name: Ram
ram.role: Son of Hezron and ancestor of Boaz
ram.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ram.importance: Ram does nothing in this book. The closing list names him as Hezron’s son and Amminadab’s father.
ram.connections: Son of Hezron. Father of Amminadab.

amminadab.name: Amminadab
amminadab.role: Father of Nahshon and ancestor of Boaz
amminadab.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
amminadab.importance: Amminadab does nothing in this book. The closing list names him as Ram’s son and Nahshon’s father.
amminadab.connections: Son of Ram. Father of Nahshon.

salmon.name: Salmon
salmon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
salmon.importance: Salmon does nothing in this book. The closing list names him as Nahshon’s son and Boaz’s father.
salmon.connections: Son of Nahshon. Father of Boaz.

nahshon.name: Nahshon
nahshon.role: Father of Salmon and ancestor of Boaz
nahshon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
nahshon.importance: Nahshon does nothing in this book. The closing list names him as Amminadab’s son and Salmon’s father.
nahshon.connections: Son of Amminadab. Father of Salmon.

leah.name: Leah
leah.role: Mother of six sons and Dinah
leah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
leah.importance: Leah does not act in this book. The people at the gate name her when they bless Ruth. They say Rachel and Leah built the house of Israel.
leah.connections: Daughter of Laban. Wife of Jacob. Sister of Rachel.

rachel.name: Rachel
rachel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
rachel.importance: Rachel does not act in this book. The people at the gate ask the LORD to make Ruth like her and Leah. They say both women built the house of Israel.
rachel.connections: Daughter of Laban. Wife of Jacob. Sister of Leah.

judah.name: Judah
judah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
judah.importance: Judah does not act in this book. The people at the gate name him in their blessing. They say Tamar bore Perez to Judah.
judah.connections: Son of Jacob and Leah. Father of Perez and Zerah through Tamar.

tamar.name: Tamar
tamar.role: Mother of Perez, named in the gate blessing
tamar.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
tamar.importance: Tamar does not act in this book. The people at the gate say she bore Perez to Judah. They ask that Boaz’s house be like the house of Perez.
tamar.connections: Widow of Er and Onan. Mother of Perez and Zerah.
